prior_ordering_evidence: SSDD DEV187 RFDETR_DEV187_FIXED_LOGIT_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL_20261109.md. Directional context improved AP but that setup failed its strict-retention criterion.

arms.radial: same samples sorted independently within each radius
arms.ordered: oriented row-major samples within each radius

features: 14 original native features plus two square rings of author-pre-resize query logits. Radius 1 (8 samples) and 3 (24) in 144×144 cells. Native centers in 800×800 with bilinear align_corners=False and border padding. Coordinate system shared by all arms.
design: Freeze ordered and radial arrays before attaching the held label data. This probe changes only the appended 32 features. All three arms have the same 46-dimensional paired head, objective BCE + 0.25 ordinary pairwise, shared 5217 initialization and batch schedule. Existing first-layer weights mapped to unchanged channels, and appended weights shared across arms. Same endpoint support, fixed per-candidate k and same all-candidate scoring.
advance: Ordered must improve at least 0.30 AP over both controls, with AP75 and AP90 non-decreasing, at least 0.20 paired continuous IoU points with positive 95% interval lower bounds, and no increase in strict-.90 losses. One seed FIT-exposed development only.
